stdout:
usage: nexus-relay [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR]
                   {init,invite,serve,verify,anchor,reconcile} ...

Contract-admitted, container-isolated agent runs.

positional arguments:
  {init,invite,serve,verify,anchor,reconcile}
    init                create the data directory, config and owner sign-in
                        link
    invite              print a new single-use sign-in link for an existing
                        member
    serve               run the relay
    verify              check the log chain and replay the NEXUS events
    anchor              print the current log head to record outside this
                        machine
    reconcile           repair runs interrupted between NEXUS and the room
                        database (dry run by default)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --data-dir DATA_DIR
